packageRules.description: Docker major updates require manual merge
Automerge all igou images including majors
Disable digest pinning for OCI helm charts managed by kustomize
llmkube chart and controller image are a lockstep compatibility contract; newer controller builds can drop chart-required args and crash-loop (exit 2). Bump both together manually, not via Renovate.

Forgejo chart uses nonstandard image.tag + image.digest fields (the chart concatenates them into one image ref). The standard helm-values manager glues pin digests into tag here (incidents 2026-09-13 #937/#942 and 2026-09-21 #972/#988); the regex custom manager owns this pin instead.

customManagers.description: democratic-csi driver image pinned via inline tag@sha256 (chart's nonstandard image.registry+image.tag schema isn't picked up by helm-values manager)
Tag-free digest-only app-template images (repository + digest, no tag) tracking the upstream latest channel; helm-values manager can't update the separate digest field
Digest-only plain-manifest images (image: repo@sha256, no tag) tracking the upstream latest channel; the kubernetes manager can't update tag-free refs

Forgejo chart pin: image.tag and image.digest are separate fields the chart concatenates; this regex manager owns the pin (helm-values manager is disabled for this file by packageRule, incidents #937/#942 and #972/#988)
